spells.name: Arcane Armor
spells.shortDescription: Summon a light magical armor on self.
spells.effect: Add Armor bonus to Spellcraft Tier (minimum 1) if unarmored. Cannot be re-summoned if dispelled with non-full stamina HP.
spells.description: Arcane Armor is rarely used in wars, and until higher tiers it is weaker defense than an actual physical armor. Despite that it is quite popular spell to learn, as Arcane Armor is weightless and requires no maintenance.  Authors note: put on a good enchanted brigantine and a nice helmet. No one needs to see your amazing hairstyle during the battle.

spells.name: Basic Elemental Invocation
spells.shortDescription: Channel the ambient element of your zone to produce a minor elemental effect.
spells.effect: Tap into a zone with an abundance of an element (see [[Elemental Mage]]) to produce a small, useful effect of that element — a spark from a fire, a gust from wind, a splash from water. Not enough to deal damage directly, but enough to interact with the environment.

spells.name: Consecrate
spells.shortDescription: Spend an breather consecrating one zone for up to a full day, making it uncomfortable for undead and monsters.
spells.description: Spend an breather consecrating one zone for up to a full day, making it uncomfortable for undead and monsters.

spells.name: Darkvision
spells.shortDescription: Grant darkvision to self or team
spells.effect: Black and white darkvision. At Party cost, affects your team and extends +1 connected zone per Spellcraft tier.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.shortDescription: Sense magical auras and enchantments
spells.effect: See magic auras in your zone

spells.name: Endure Elements
spells.shortDescription: Resist environmental extremes
spells.effect: Ignore minor environmental effects, like rain or dust storm. #TODO Environmental rules are not yet written

spells.name: Featherfall
spells.shortDescription: Negate falling damage for targets
spells.effect: Negate falling damage on 1 or more targets in your zone.

spells.name: Ghost Sound
spells.shortDescription: Create illusory sounds
spells.effect: Audio illusion

spells.name: Lend Vitality
spells.shortDescription: Transfer your stamina to an ally
spells.effect: Transfer up to `[Spellcraft × 6]` stamina from yourself to 1 ally. Cannot transfer more stamina than you currently have.

spells.name: Light
spells.shortDescription: Create small lamp level illumination around yourself or party
spells.effect: Bright light filling your zone, centered on you. At Party cost, also affects allies and extends +1 connected zone per Spellcraft tier. Can change color and intensity of the light.
spells.description: Third most popular awakening spell and first spell taught to the students. The color of the light coming from the spell can be modified. Research has shown that the spell is way better for nigh-time reading than candles or lamps, as it doesn't cause as much stress to the eyes.
spells.duration: 1 breather if cast as a spell

spells.name: Light Backpack
spells.shortDescription: Reduce the weight you carry in your backpack.
spells.effect: Reduce the weight of the backpack(s) you and/or your team carry by 5 × Tier kilos.
spells.description: This spell is ignored by the novice adventurers until their first long distance mission when those extra 20kg of pelts or 20 daily rations would have felt amazing.  The need for the spell disappears when they are rich enough for spacial bags, and it becomes disregarded again.

spells.name: Light Feet
spells.shortDescription: Ignore difficult terrain while traveling
spells.effect: You and/or your team ignore difficult terrain while traveling.

spells.name: Loud Mouth
spells.shortDescription: Amplify your voice significantly
spells.effect: Amplify your voice 5 times

spells.name: Message
spells.shortDescription: Create a telepathic communication
spells.effect: Telepathic whisper; ignores range and visibility reqs for team members

spells.name: Minor Disruption
spells.shortDescription: Disrupt a duration spell within range
spells.effect: Attempt to disrupt a duration spell in your zone, DC=10+CastersBonus, doesn't work on spells in limits

spells.name: Minor Elemental Manipulation
spells.shortDescription: Produce or manipulate small amounts of elements
spells.effect: 1d3 damage if used offensively. Doesn't scale. Can produce flame, water, acid, move earth/stone, cool drinks.

spells.name: Minor Telekinesis
spells.shortDescription: Telekinetic manipulation of small objects
spells.effect: 2kg max; move the object within your zone, moving it to a connected zone costs 1 AP; hard to aim to drop things

spells.name: Phantom Tools
spells.shortDescription: Create phantom tools for a skill you have
spells.effect: Create phantom tools for a skill you have

spells.name: Prestidigitation
spells.shortDescription: Minor magical effects for cleaning, flavoring, and coloring
spells.effect: Cosmetic effects

spells.name: Resistance
spells.shortDescription: Minor protection from one damage type
spells.effect: Reduce damage from chosen type by `[Spellcraft]`.

spells.name: Sad violin
spells.shortDescription: Play ambient musical composition for the scene
spells.effect: Play prerecorded musical composition as ambient music for the scene

spells.name: Stabilize
spells.shortDescription: Conduct magical first aid
spells.effect: First aid

spells.name: Wish-em Good Luck
spells.shortDescription: Give advantage to an ally.
spells.effect: The ally's next roll is affected by Good #Luck
spells.description: People talk a lot, and mages are no exception. To use this spell you must mean it. Learning this spell is considered a funny challenge in magical community, but not all pass. It requires to speak what you mean for a day while actively interacting with other people. If you lie or say something you don't believe in, the you need to start all over.

spells.name: Alarming Wards
spells.shortDescription: Cover one zone with a movement detection spell.
spells.effect: Cover one zone in a movement detection ward. Larger areas: apply per zone or use [[Metamagic]] (Widened).
spells.description: Bread and butter of adventurers and bodyguards. Despite its common use and relative ease of detection by trained thieves and assassins this is a one of the pillars of security systems. Note from author: Dear adventurers, if your travel in the wilderness and your support mage doesn't know this spell - you need to find another one.

spells.name: Alter Shape
spells.shortDescription: Adjust facial features and body shape to impersonate others
spells.effect: You change your visuals and optionally your team members'. You can't change body mass. This doesn't hide voices, acting skills, or similar. Provides +3 to Fast-talk and Acting when impersonating a role.
spells.description: The Bread and Butter of spies, thieves and actors. While it is not illegal to change one's shape, impersonation is illegal and most wealthy and some well-off establishments have wards against transformation and illusion spells, highlighting the illusion for all present.

spells.name: Animate Appliance
spells.shortDescription: Animate household appliances to do simple menial labor
spells.effect: Animate a number of appliances equal to your Spellcraft to do the work for you.
spells.description: Animate Appliance is the favorite tool in poor students', pathological loners and disenfranchised nobles' hands. This spell will do the untrained monotonous labor worse than any professional cleaner or a maid, but maids are expensive and you are cheap.

spells.name: Aura of Speed
spells.shortDescription: Increase team Speed
spells.effect: +1 #Enhancement bonus to Speed to the team
spells.description: Reaching places in time is important. you should try it as well. With this spell your movement will be a breeze.

spells.name: Awaken
spells.shortDescription: Wake unconscious allies and clear stun
spells.effect: Wake unconscious targets. Attempt to remove [[Condition - Stunned]] on the whole team or 1 target.

spells.name: Bestial Arms
spells.shortDescription: Grow claws and defensive arm covering
spells.effect: You get up to two 1d4 Unarmed or 1H weapons with #Light and #Reach traits. You can unarmed deflect with them.
spells.description: Basic transformation step on a way to become a furry beast. The utility of this spell is overrated, as a dagger is more versatile.  Authors note: I've only seen druids and furry pervs use this spell, and in Elzmeer we don't teach druidism. This spell won't count for exam qualifications.

spells.name: Binding Chains
spells.shortDescription: Bind target with magical chains to restrict movement
spells.effect: Target's speed is reduced to 1, Target can attempt to break the chain, which has Tier* 6 HP, or do a Break roll (breaking skill/MG vs Spellcraft) for 2AP.

spells.name: Elemental Strike
spells.shortDescription: Attack a target with chosen elemental damage
spells.effect: `[Spellcraft]d6` damage of chosen element on a hit
spells.description: The most versatile offensive spell out there. People enlarge it, make it into cones, rays, bursts and walls.

spells.name: Elemental Weapon
spells.shortDescription: Imbue weapon(s) with your element
spells.effect: Imbue weapon(s) with an element of your choice. Weapons deal +`[Spellcraft]` elemental damage.

spells.name: Empower Weapons
spells.shortDescription: Empower weapons with magic for extra damage
spells.effect: You and/or allies in your zone deal +1 weapon damage. This is an Equipment bonus.

spells.name: Healing Aura
spells.shortDescription: Heal surface injuries of your team.
spells.effect: Spellcraft HP of healing per turn for all allies. Heals first health then stamina damage. Stacks with similar healing effects.
spells.description: The main reason to have a mage in the group.

spells.name: Levitation
spells.shortDescription: Levitate targets to move them through the air
spells.effect: Each AP spent moves 1 target within its zone; moving it to a connected zone costs 1 AP. Can affect yourself, 1 target, or your whole team. Any successful attack against you requires an Endure check or your ability to hold the spell falters.

spells.name: Minor Curse
spells.shortDescription: Place minor inconvenient curses on enemies
spells.effect: Give your enemy digestive issues or a nasty pimple on the nose, make them stab their toe twice tomorrow, give them a few days of sexual dysfunction. This is a subtle spell, and someone without knowledge in arcane will not understand that you are cursing them not badmouthing. If they are roll opposed arcane check to hide the presence of the curse.

spells.name: Minor Healing
spells.shortDescription: Instant single-target heal
spells.effect: Heal `[Spellcraft]d6` HP. Only fixes HP/Stamina pools.

spells.name: Obscure
spells.shortDescription: Make yourself or team less noticeable from distance
spells.effect: All enemies outside your skirmish roll contested stealth checks against you with disadvantage.

spells.name: Pest control
spells.shortDescription: Control pest population in a small area.
spells.effect: This ritual has 3 modes of operation.
spells.description: Decades ago the Elzmeer academy student developed this ritual to clean the dorm from pests, It was so efficient, that he dropped out of the academy, took a loan and opened his own business. Sadly, it was too good, and the city was cleansed of pests in a year. To avoid bankruptcy he lowered the spell intensity to just shoo the critters away into other houses. That wasn't enough to save his failing business venture. Thus, the reverse of the ritual was invented. It led to his execution a few weeks later.

spells.name: Profanity filter
spells.shortDescription: Counter curses and profanity by silencing offenders
spells.effect: When a creatures curses, tries to summon profane beings or casts a curse - you try to shut them up. Contest against their endure (if no magic) or spellcraft. On a success, they lose their actions spent to cast the spell and cannot speak until the end of their turn. If it was a curse or the target takes 3 damage as they bite their tongue.

spells.name: Resist Element
spells.shortDescription: Resistance to an element of your choice
spells.effect: Resistance to an element of your choice. Reduces incoming damage by `[Spellcraft]`.

spells.name: Simple barrier
spells.shortDescription: Place magical barriers to block or bridge
spells.effect: Barrier 1m² block can sustain 120KG of static pressure and take Spellcraft x d8 damage before crumbling. You can layer the barrier.

spells.name: Summon Skelly boys
spells.shortDescription: Summon skeleton minions for combat
spells.effect: #TODO Summoning rules. I have the vision, just need to formalize it.

spells.name: Summon weapon
spells.shortDescription: Summon an ephemeral weapon that seeks blood
spells.effect: Summon an ephemeral weapon that you can use. You can only have 1. It disappears if removed from your hand. If there is no combat the weapon disappears. If you end up not using the weapon to attack until the end of the combat - the weapon strikes you with your modifier.
spells.duration: Until the end of the combat encounter.

spells.name: Telekinetic Maneuver
spells.shortDescription: Push, pull, or trip targets telekinetically
spells.effect: Contested check to perform a combat maneuver. On success the target is moved or prone.

spells.name: Tentacle arms
spells.shortDescription: Transform limbs into tentacles with extended reach
spells.effect: Your tentacles count as reach weapons (attack a skirmish without entering it), but have no fine manipulators. Removes manacles that don't prevent casting spells.
spells.duration: 1 shift, cannot be self dispelled. Because you don't have hands to dispell

spells.name: Cleanse Food and Water
spells.shortDescription: Remove poison and disease from food and water
spells.effect: Remove poison and disease from food and water. 1 minute per serving.

spells.name: Cure Affliction
spells.shortDescription: Cure disease, poison, sickness, contagion
spells.effect: Cure disease, poison, sickness, contagion in 1 target.

spells.name: Elemental Armor
spells.shortDescription: Elemental armor that hurts melee attackers
spells.effect: Effect of [[Resist Element]]. Melee attackers take `[Spellcraft] × 2` element damage.

spells.name: Major Healing
spells.shortDescription: Strong single-target heal that also patches minor wounds
spells.effect: Heal `[Spellcraft]d10` HP. Heals consequences 0.

spells.name: Restore Senses
spells.shortDescription: Restore lost senses
spells.effect: Cure temporary Blinded, Deafened, Dumb. Heals up to severity 2 sensory wounds.

spells.name: Summon Elemental
spells.shortDescription: Summon an elemental servant
spells.effect: Summon an elemental of an element you control. It follows your orders. If destroyed, you cannot reallocate the spent limit until taking a breather.

spells.name: Summon Elemental Weapon
spells.shortDescription: Summon an elemental weapon
spells.effect: #TODO

spells.name: Aura of Health
spells.shortDescription: Healing Aura that also grants disease and poison resistance
spells.effect: Upgrades [[Healing Aura]]: same passive heal + all allies get +`[Spellcraft]` to Endure checks vs disease, poison, exhaustion.

spells.name: Cloud walking
spells.shortDescription: Walk on clouds and air
spells.effect: #TODO

spells.name: Elemental Form
spells.shortDescription: Become your element
spells.effect: Become immune to an element.

spells.name: Elemental Manipulation
spells.shortDescription: Freeform control of your element
spells.effect: Freeform control of your element in your zone and connected zones. Move `[Spellcraft] × 2` volume of element per round (fire, water, earth, air).

spells.name: Healing Slumber
spells.shortDescription: Magical sleep that accelerates recovery
spells.effect: Puts willing characters to slumber. While sleeping, recovery quality counts as at least +3 or adds +1, whichever is higher, for purposes of recovery.

spells.name: Restoration
spells.shortDescription: Magically patch newly acquired wounds
spells.effect: Attempt to patch newly acquired wound. Counts as Surgery; if conducted with surgery, counts as Enhanced treatment.

spells.name: Restore Mind
spells.shortDescription: Clear mental magical and alchemical effects
spells.effect: Attempt to clear compulsion, charm, and other mental magical or alchemical effects.

spells.name: Control Weather
spells.shortDescription: Control weather
spells.effect: Currents, rain, snow, storm.

spells.name: Halt Aging
spells.shortDescription: Halt the aging process
spells.effect: Target doesn't age while the spell is active.

spells.name: Major Elemental Manipulation
spells.shortDescription: Massive scale elemental control
spells.effect: Massive quantities: tons of stone, flood a zone, create a firestorm, sustained hurricane. GM adjudicates scope per element. Lasts `[Spellcraft]` rounds.

spells.name: Regeneration
spells.shortDescription: Persistent regeneration
spells.effect: Regen `[Spellcraft]d6` HP/round. Consider healing conditions +4 or add +2, whichever is higher. Every Tenday a medic can attempt to remove a Permanent consequence with a surgery.

spells.name: Resuscitate
spells.shortDescription: Heal a dead body to enable revival
spells.effect: Allows healing of the dead body to lower Life and Death check difficulty, or allow it in case of injuries incompatible with life. Failure = the spell doesn't work.

spells.name: Resurrection
spells.shortDescription: Raise the dead
spells.effect: Raise the dead. State of the body incurs penalty.

spells.name: Youth
spells.shortDescription: Reverse the aging process
spells.effect: Targets grow younger with each day for a day.
